---
title: "How to cite"
---

## Acknowledge the server

Please include this text in the acknowledgments of papers, theses, and
presentations that use data from this server:

> {{< var acknowledgment >}}

Telling us about your publications helps us justify continued funding for the
server; see [Report a problem](report.qmd) for how to reach us.

## Cite the models

Each CMIP6 dataset has its own citation and license, set by the modeling
group. Find them through the
[CMIP6 citation service](https://cmip6cite.wdc-climate.de/) using the
dataset id from the [browser](browse.qmd), and follow the
[CMIP6 terms of use](https://pcmdi.llnl.gov/CMIP6/TermsOfUse).
For reanalysis, cite the product's own reference (for ERA5:
Hersbach et al., 2020, <https://doi.org/10.1002/qj.3803>), and include any
acknowledgment the provider requests.
Each non-CMIP6 dataset page shows its product's citation and license;
products not in the catalog have theirs on [Other holdings](holdings.qmd).

### NOAA-CIRES-DOE Twentieth Century Reanalysis version 3 (20CRv3)

NOAA PSL asks that papers using 20CRv3 include this text in their
acknowledgments:

> Support for the Twentieth Century Reanalysis Project version 3 dataset is
> provided by the U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Science Biological and
> Environmental Research (BER), by the National Oceanic and Atmospheric
> Administration Climate Program Office, and by the NOAA Earth System Research
> Laboratory Physical Sciences Laboratory.

## Catalog versions

If your analysis depends on the exact holdings, record the catalog version
(currently `{{< var catalog_version >}}`) in your methods. A DOI for the
server and its catalog snapshots is under consideration.
